findings.ownership_disposition: Resolved narrowly by project binding, canonical authorization roots, per-agent grants, bounded execution, and an operator-owned persisted policy. The current schema-v2 policy is enabled on clean installs. Released schema-v1 configs persisted no provenance capable of distinguishing the shipped disabled default from a user-chosen false value, so their disabled state migrates to enabled; explicit schema-v2 opt-outs record provenance and remain disabled. Agent or model arguments cannot change that policy. shell_exec retains its synchronous login-Bash compatibility contract; clean-profile bash.run is additive. findings.ownership_disposition: Protocol v5 makes successful renameatx_np(..., RENAME_EXCL) the capture linearization point and distinguishes currentEntry, namespaceVersionExact, and contentVersionExact. The canonical request digest binds request and transaction identifiers, project generation, authorized root, relative components, access, contract, and expected identity where applicable. New phase records use schema 3 with explicit request-protocol and digest-canonicalization versions; only the exact schema-2 protocol-v4 nil-version/nil-contract/nil-digest shape with an expected identity is migrated. The partial P10 boundary routes non-directory leaf deletion through a separately signed root LaunchDaemon, exact-caller authenticated XPC, a same-volume root-owned mode-0700 namespace, and 32 fixed durable transaction slots. Namespace-exact mismatch and post-capture metadata change retain the captured object in protected quarantine without disposal; content-exact fails closed because exclusive writer proof is absent. Valid transaction-bound pending capture-identity receipts are adopted before general cleanup. Documented atomic-capture errors that leave both names unchanged become acknowledgeable rejected outcomes instead of indefinitely consuming a slot. Legacy restore is reported only after exact source identity proof; all unprovable legacy restore cases and absent v5 protected captures become durable conflicts. Automatic privileged restore through a relocatable source parent remains disabled. This is mitigation, not elimination. Public macOS descriptor-relative open, stat, unlink, rename, renameatx_np, descriptor, fcntl, fsync, and F_FULLFSYNC interfaces do not combine terminal namespace mutation with an expected device, inode, vnode generation, or content token. Source-parent authorization and capture are not atomic: same-UID relocation can move the validated pinned parent outside the authorized root before capture. One winning race can delete one eligible outside-root regular file or symlink whose bytes are unbounded, or quarantine one ineligible directory whose subtree is unbounded. A same-UID writer can also substitute the final source entry before exclusive capture. Under currentEntry the successful capture defines the entry; under namespaceVersionExact a token mismatch cannot be disposed. The final ACL/BSD-metadata-check-to-unlinkat race can delete one already captured expected regular file or symlink after its authorization metadata changes; regular-file bytes are unbounded. Terminal quarantine has no authorized restore, release, or purge disposition and cannot be acknowledged while the protected leaf exists; 32 conflicts can exhaust every protected slot on one volume. Caller-ledger removal, relocation, or lock-inode replacement and project-generation races can strand or allow up to 32 captured or terminal transactions per protected volume; each affected regular file can contain unbounded bytes. Writable descriptors and hard links prevent an exact immutable-content guarantee. Startup recovery fencing, terminal physical-state repair, caller-ledger and generation fencing, daemon-owned discovery and revoke, project-binding revoke and garbage collection, qualified external/removable volume behavior, whole-product freshness, direct daemon execution, and the full signed distinct-process 57-row crash, adversarial, lifecycle, volume, hard-link, writable-descriptor, Release, and notarization matrix remain open. Source checkpoint 2dd504e53a5a09837cd289a99eee48ab7f4547eb adds evidence-control schema v2 and artifact-binding schema v1, recorder-owned evidence-specific copies, exact case/role/iteration/subject/predicate/fact and qualification-context binding, current-manifest and Git execution identity checks, bounded descriptor reads, and pathname replacement/rewrite negative tests. The evidence-control suite passed 57 of 57 tests in its final repeated validation. The template remains partial with all 57 rows not_run, all 12 formal predicates false, zero formal references, and a null qualification-context reference. These are controls only: they do not execute a signed distinct-process case, prove a claim true, provide an identity-conditional macOS mutation, or close any formal predicate. Qualification still assumes a trusted quiescent workspace against same-UID transient source-manifest replacement; an arbitrary caller-selected harness is not authenticated; aggregate report and evidence input reads remain unbounded fail-closed denial-of-service surfaces; the G10 handler does not yet invoke this checker; and post-verification mutation remains outside immutable-content proof. FC-FILESYSTEM-PATH-TOCTOU-001 / FCA-007, E2, P10, G10, and G12 remain mandatory release blockers. G09 continuity, G11 hardware, native signing/UI, and final release qualification also remain open and release-blocking. Bounded shell compatibility is resolved only under FC-SHELL-COMPAT-QUALIFICATION-001.
findings.title: Filesystem mutation paths retain descriptor-relative race windows
